senses.gloss: ch. same, to cut, break into pieces.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 2:6">Targ. Y. Lev. II, 6</cite> Ar. (ed. <he>רסיק</he>).—Y. Ber. VI, 10ᵃ bot. <he>כד הוה קָצֵי הוה טעים וכ׳</he> whenever he broke bread, he tasted (carrying a piece to his mouth) with his left hand, and distributed with the right hand. Ib. VIII, 12ᵃ bot. [read:] <he>יהב ליה עגולה דיִקְצֵי</he> he handed him a loaf to break it.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 6:9:13">Y. Sabb. VI, end, 8ᵈ</cite> [read:] <he>קְצִינָן פלגא וכ׳</he> we broke off one half and gave it to him; a. e.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 108a:3">B. Mets. 108ᵃ</cite> <he>מאן קַצְיֵיה</he>, v. <cite ref="S00529"><he>קוּץ</he></cite> III ch.

senses.gloss: to set aside, make unavailable for any other purpose.
units: <cite ref="Sukkah 37b:4">Succ. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>כי אַקְצְיֵיה מריחא אקצייה</he> when he designated it (the myrtle branch) for religious use, he made it unavailable for smelling; <he>מאכילה אקצייה</he> made it unavailable for eating.

senses.gloss: to place in a corner.—Part. pass. f. מַקְצְיָא.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 17a:2">Yoma 17ᵃ</cite> <he>האי לשכה אַקְצוּיֵי מקציא וכ׳</he> that cell was situated in an angle (south-west corner); to him that came from the north it appeared to be in the south &c.

senses.gloss: to be set aside, be made unavailable.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 43a:9">Sabb. 43ᵃ</cite> <he>מיגו דא׳ לבין השמשות א׳ וכ׳</he> since it was forbidden to handle it at twilight (when the Sabbath entered), it became so for the entire day; <cite ref="Sukkah 46b">Succ. 46ᵇ</cite>.

<cite ref="Sukkah 46b:3">Ib.</cite> <he>למצותה א׳</he> it was designated only for the religious ceremony (and forbidden for any other use until the ceremony has been performed); <he>לכוליה יומא א׳</he> it is unavailable for the entire day (even after the ceremony has been performed); a. e.
